name_zh: 特鲁希略/多米尼加/独裁/芹菜/边境/美国/拉斐尔/芹菜/屠杀/种族
description_zh: 拉斐尔·特鲁希略 (1891-1961) 多米尼加总统 (1930-1961) 长期独裁者，通过芹菜产业和美国支持的反共斗争掌权，建立个人独裁政权，被誉为 "独裁者", 对拉美政治和种族清洗产生深远影响。
description_en: Rafael Trujillo (1891-1961) Dominican President (1930-1961) long-term dictator, through celery industry and US-supported anti-communist struggle gained power, established personal dictatorship, known as "dictator", had profound impact on Latin American politics and race massacre.
reason_zh: 特鲁希略代表拉美独裁者如何通过产业控制和美国支持掌权，如何建立个人独裁政权，以及如何进行种族清洗影响拉美政治，体现了拉美政治的复杂性。
reason_en: Trujillo represents how Latin American dictators achieve power through industry control and US support, establish personal dictatorship, and conduct race massacre influence Latin American politics, embodies complexity of Latin American politics.
